findings.title: Stamp-only 3.0.6 edge silently drops RLS policies, functional indexes and grants on every existing database
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The new 3.0.6 data edge runs the full bundle, which opens with DROP SCHEMA eql_v3 CASCADE and has no dependency protections (per safe-eql-reinstall.md), so dependent policies, indexes and grants are dropped on every existing database for a stamp-only release.

findings.title: 1.x upgrade holds locks for two full bundle reinstalls in one transaction
findings.label: valid
findings.note: 1.x databases now walk both the 3.0.5 and 3.0.6 reinstall edges in one migrate, as the migration header and changeset confirm, which lengthens the cascading-DDL lock window; this is plausible, though the transaction behaviour is not directly verified.

findings.title: Relaxed lockstep marker lets stack-prisma ship baking 3.0.6 against @cipherstash/eql 3.0.5
findings.label: valid
findings.note: At head eql is 3.0.5 while the migrations bake 3.0.6; the lockstep test only requires that some migration bakes the installed digest and the marker accepts both versions, so nothing offline blocks a stack-prisma release that pins eql 3.0.5 while installing 3.0.6.
